backend/main.mo: Motoko canister defining user profiles, submissions, timers, alerts, and market intelligence storage with access control and HTTP transformation support.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to affected files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose and behavior of major frontend files and pages.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining light/dark theme CSS variables and applying global background and text colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point setting up root container and loading the main React script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app router with theme provider, layout structure, header/footer, and all route definitions.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Scrollable bottom navigation bar with route buttons, active highlighting, and integrated site search modal.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with branding, social links, and a copyright notice.
frontend/src/components/FormsSection.tsx: Wraps and displays the registration forms with a heading and animated section transition.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Implements a responsive header with navigation menus, search, mobile menu, and dynamic scroll styling.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Displays the homepage hero with branding, call‑to‑action buttons, and animated protocol stats.
frontend/src/components/MarketIntelSkele: Provides skeleton placeholders for the Market Intel page while data loads.
frontend/src/components/MotionSafe.tsx: Handles motion‑safe animations based on user preferences and visibility delay.
frontend/src/components/MySubmissions.ts: Shows the user's submission history with loading, empty, error, and table states.
frontend/src/components/OracleSection.ts: Renders simulated market signals with confidence scores and animated oracle intelligence UI.
frontend/src/components/PageHead.tsx: Sets the document title and meta description for a page.
frontend/src/components/PageShell.tsx: Provides a layout wrapper with configurable max‑width and padded container.
frontend/src/components/RegistrationForm: Handles presale and airdrop form state, validation, submission, timer locks, and WhatsApp fallback behavior.
frontend/src/components/ScrollToTop.tsx: Shows a floating button that appears after scrolling and smoothly scrolls the page to the top.
frontend/src/components/searchIndex.ts: Static search index defining searchable paths, titles, descriptions, and keywords.
frontend/src/components/SiteSearch.tsx: Modal search component that filters a predefined index and navigates to selected results.
frontend/src/components/SmokySectionTran: Scroll-triggered visibility wrapper using IntersectionObserver with optional delay.
frontend/src/components/WhitepaperSectio: Whitepaper promo section with animated cards and navigation button, wrapped in a scroll transition.
frontend/src/constants/socialLinks.ts: Centralized constants for external social and messaging URLs.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for Internet Identity authentication, handling login, logout, stored identities, and status management.
frontend/src/hooks/useParallax.ts: Defines scroll- and pointer-based parallax hooks that adjust offset values while respecting reduced‑motion preferences.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Wraps backend actor calls with React Query hooks for submitting forms, fetching submissions and timers, and managing market intelligence access.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures Tailwind layers, theme variables, animations, and utility classes for global styling and motion‑reduction behavior.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider, then renders App.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders an About page describing RBS values using styled sections, icons, and animated transitions.
frontend/src/pages/AcquisitionPage.tsx: Displays the Acquisition Portal with presale/airdrop registration forms, user submissions, and allocation stats.
frontend/src/pages/AdvancedAnalyticsPage: Empty page component with no content.
frontend/src/pages/AISentimentPage.tsx: Empty page component with no content.
frontend/src/pages/AlertsCenterPage.tsx: Interactive alerts dashboard allowing users to view, create, mark as read, delete, and clear alerts using query hooks.
frontend/src/pages/CommunityGovernancePa: Static content page describing RBS community governance features, proposal systems, and voting structure.
frontend/src/pages/CommunityHighlightsPa: Showcases community achievements, featured members, initiatives, and statistics with structured UI sections.
frontend/src/pages/CommunityVotingPage.t: Explains upcoming decentralized voting features and provides informational UI about proposals and voting power.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Provides a contact form that opens the user's email client and links to direct communication channels.
frontend/src/pages/DeveloperBlogPage.tsx: Empty page placeholder for future developer blog content.
frontend/src/pages/DeveloperToolsPage.ts: Empty page placeholder for future developer tools content.
frontend/src/pages/EcosystemGrowthPage.t: Renders the Ecosystem Growth page with sections highlighting community building, partnerships, integrations, and various growth initiatives using styled cards and icons.
frontend/src/pages/FAQPage.tsx: Displays an interactive FAQ list with collapsible answers covering RBS token details, governance, tokenomics, roadmap, and participation instructions.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Implements the homepage with dynamic greeting, animated metrics, branding elements, and introductory text about RBS's community-driven vision.
frontend/src/pages/InsightsPage.tsx: Shows market, economic, and governance insights along with technical highlights and industry trends using structured data and progress visuals.
frontend/src/pages/LivePricePage.tsx: Empty page placeholder for future live price display.
frontend/src/pages/MarketIntelPage.tsx: Provides a gated market intelligence dashboard with access control, asset/timeframe selection, and retrieval of standard or binary trading signals.
frontend/src/pages/MarketPulsePage.tsx: Page displaying real-time market sentiment, macro events, and weekly market highlights with periodic sentiment updates.
frontend/src/pages/NotFoundPage.tsx: Custom 404 page with navigation options and links to key site sections.
frontend/src/pages/PartnersPage.tsx: Empty placeholder page for future partners content.
frontend/src/pages/RoadmapPage.tsx: Roadmap view outlining project milestones from 2026–2030 with phases and completion statuses.
frontend/src/pages/SecurityTransparencyP: Page presenting security measures, transparency metrics, and risk management details.
frontend/src/pages/TestimonialsPage.tsx: Testimonials page showcasing community feedback and project-related stats.
frontend/src/pages/TokenomicsPage.tsx: Tokenomics page showing token distribution, total supply, and an interactive pie chart.
frontend/src/pages/WhitepaperPage.tsx: Renders the whitepaper page with chapter navigation and scroll-based active section tracking using IntersectionObserver.
frontend/src/utils/binarySignal.ts: Converts MarketIntelligence data into CALL/PUT binary signals with confidence scoring based on signal strength and historical accuracy.
frontend/src/utils/errors.ts: Provides sanitized user-friendly error messages and determines whether errors are retryable.
frontend/src/utils/forms.ts: Validates and normalizes Presale/Airdrop form data and supplies helpers for resetting forms.
frontend/src/utils/timers.ts: Processes backend nanosecond timer values into readable UI timer data and formatting helpers.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Manages URL and sessionStorage parameters, supporting hash-based routing and persistence.
frontend/src/utils/whatsapp.ts: Builds WhatsApp message payloads and opens WhatsApp URLs with fallback detection.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind theme, colors, animations, and plugins for the frontend.
project_state.json: Stores current project state, required fixes, known issues, and design asset requirements.
